## MGIT Students Participate in Interactive Session with HH Chinna Jeeyar Swamiji

News Date : 19 Sep 2025News ReportMGIT Students Participate in Interactive Session with HH Chinna Jeeyar SwamijiAs part of the First-Year Induction Program (UHV Cell Activity), a group of 50 first-year MME students from MGIT participated in an inspiring interactive session with His Holiness Sri Tridandi Chinna Jeeyar Swamiji on 19th September 2025 at Ramanagaram, Muchintal.The session was organized under the “Vikas Tharangini – A Vision Beyond Boundaries” initiative, which witnessed the participation of 500 students from 25 engineering colleges across Hyderabad and Rangareddy districts.Addressing the gathering, HH Chinna Jeeyar Swamiji emphasized that while acquiring new scientific and technological knowledge, students must also cultivate discipline, character, responsibility, and human values. He highlighted that true education lies in balancing academic excellence with moral responsibility and cultural awareness.The participation of MGIT students in this unique session enriched their induction experience and motivated them to pursue knowledge with integrity while contributing positively to society.The initiative was coordinated by Dr KumaraSwamy of UHV Cell of MGIT under the guidance of Prof. G. Chandramohan Reddy, Principal, MGIT.

MGIT Students Participate in Interactive Session with HH Chinna Jeeyar Swamiji
As part of the First-Year Induction Program (UHV Cell Activity), a group of 50 first-year MME students from MGIT participated in an inspiring interactive session with His Holiness Sri Tridandi Chinna Jeeyar Swamiji on 19th September 2025 at Ramanagaram, Muchintal.
The session was organized under the “Vikas Tharangini – A Vision Beyond Boundaries” initiative, which witnessed the participation of 500 students from 25 engineering colleges across Hyderabad and Rangareddy districts.
Addressing the gathering, HH Chinna Jeeyar Swamiji emphasized that while acquiring new scientific and technological knowledge, students must also cultivate discipline, character, responsibility, and human values. He highlighted that true education lies in balancing academic excellence with moral responsibility and cultural awareness.
The participation of MGIT students in this unique session enriched their induction experience and motivated them to pursue knowledge with integrity while contributing positively to society.
The initiative was coordinated by Dr KumaraSwamy of UHV Cell of MGIT under the guidance of Prof. G. Chandramohan Reddy, Principal, MGIT.
